observation_indicators.observable_fil: Para sa Tsaang gubat, itugma ang botanical name, bahagi at nakalistang gamit. Ipaliwanag ang hangganan at konsultasyon.
observation_indicators.observable_en: For Tsaang gubat, match the botanical name, plant part and listed use. Explain the boundary and consultation need.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Kinokopya ang dose mula sa lumang table o sinasabing ligtas inumin ni Rosa ang Tsaang gubat.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Copies a dose from the old table or says Tsaang gubat is safe for Rosa to drink.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Itinutugma ang Carmona retusa at dahon, walang binabanggit na dami at iniuugnay sa health professional ang lumalalang sakit ni Rosa nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Matches Carmona retusa and leaves, names no amount and refers Rosa's worsening pain to a health professional without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang card ngunit kailangan ng paalala para kumilos sa lumalalang sakit ni Rosa.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Matches the card but needs a prompt to act on Rosa's worsening pain.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Kinokopya ang dose mula sa lumang table o sinasabing ligtas inumin ni Rosa ang Tsaang gubat.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Copies a dose from the old table or says Tsaang gubat is safe for Rosa to drink.
